title: Punjab govt moves SC against CBI probe into ‘bribe syndicate’ linked to Mann OSD
content: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann's government has approached the Supreme Court for an urgent hearing. They aim to challenge a High Court order that mandated a CBI investigation into corruption allegations. The High Court's concerns include alleged coercive actions by the Central Bureau of Investigation in the state. The Punjab government argues that the orders violate governance principles outlined in the Constitution.

title: Opposition's anti-SIR-CEC march turns into INDIA bloc-government face-off
content: Opposition members from the INDIA bloc, led by Rahul Gandhi, organized a protest march to the Election Commission. The police stopped their march just before reaching Akashvani Bhavan, leading to a lengthy dharna by the MPs. Despite police attempts to remove the protesters, several MPs entered the Akashvani premises and continued their demonstration. Rahul Gandhi criticized Prime Minister Modi and accused his government of treasonous actions against the country.

title: Flydubai cockpit attack: Incident left Capt Machchhar with 'depressed skull fracture'
content: Captain Smit Machchhar faced serious injuries from his co-pilot during the flight's crisis situation. The co-pilot attacked him with an axe, resulting in a skull fracture that required emergency surgery. Doctors monitored his recovery closely and assisted him for further treatment in the UAE. The Indian embassy is providing support to Captain Machchhar and his family during this challenging time.

title: Rajnath launches first desi fleet support ship ‘Surya’ at Visakhapatnam
content: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched ‘Surya’, India’s first indigenously-built fleet support ship in Visakhapatnam. He also laid the keel for the fifth ship in the series and inaugurated upgraded infrastructure at Hindustan Shipyard Limited. These developments aim to enhance the Indian Navy’s operational capabilities and self-reliance in naval shipbuilding. Additionally, Rajnath announced the establishment of a second production line for Shakti engines in Koraput.

title: CBI raids CM Bhagwant Mann’s camp office, his OSD’s home in graft probe
content: CBI conducted raids on multiple locations including the camp office of Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann. The investigation stems from a High Court order based on allegations from the Enforcement Directorate. Various individuals are named in the FIR for their alleged involvement in corruption and manipulation of government processes. Mann criticized the timing of the raids as politically motivated amid upcoming elections.

title: SpaceX overpumped 128M gallons of groundwater; now Texas city has to pay $175,000
content: McGregor has agreed to pay $175,000 in penalties for groundwater overuse linked to SpaceX's activities. The city will make a one-time payment and subsequent quarterly payments over 25 years. Residents have expressed concerns over the arrangement, as SpaceX primarily drove the overpumping issue. City officials are exploring alternative water sources to address future needs. Groundwater conservation efforts will focus on monitoring and reusing available water resources.

title: ED unearths bribe racket involving top executives of 40 PSUs, banks & companies
content: Enforcement Directorate has uncovered a bribery racket involving executives from at least 40 public sector undertakings and banks. This scheme involved laundering corporate social responsibility funds through multiple trusts operated by a fake doctor. The fake doctor has been impersonating a medical professional for nearly three decades while receiving substantial donations. Investigations revealed kickbacks were paid, with funds returned to donors after deducting commissions.

title: Man deposits Rs 85.3 lakh given to him as cash gifts, gets notice; ITAT gives relief
content: In one such case in Chennai, a man received cash gifts of Rs 85.03 lakh from his relatives. The Income Tax Department began making enquiries into the source of the Rs 85.03 lakh deposited by the man. The department also sent tax notices to the relatives who had given him the cash.  The man eventually won relief in ITAT Chennai.

title: Amid Canada trade talks, NSAs discuss security coop
content: India and Canada are engaged in a security dialogue to strengthen their bilateral relations. NSA Ajit Doval hosted his Canadian counterpart David Morrison for discussions on security issues. Both nations reviewed their progress in law enforcement cooperation and identified areas for further collaboration. Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand is also scheduled to visit India later this month.

title: Election Commission: Was ready to meet 240 oppn MPs but not at their chosen venue
content: Election Commission declined a meeting with opposition MPs led by Rahul Gandhi at Parliament House annexe. The commission emphasized meetings should occur on its premises and through authorized representatives. Despite being offered a chance to submit a memorandum, the MPs rejected this proposal. The Commission stated it had not received prior appointment requests from the parties until late in the day.

title: Chang’e-6 moon soil reveals metallic iron never seen before in lunar samples
content: Recent analysis of lunar soil samples returned by China's Chang’e-6 mission revealed a unique form of iron. This iron, γ-Fe, exhibits exceptional magnetic properties, which could provide insights into the Moon's ancient magnetic field. Researchers suggest that extreme impacts on the lunar surface caused the formation and preservation of this unusual iron. The findings could enhance our understanding of the Moon's geological history and its evolution over time.

title: Maryland dairy farm spill kills nearly 11,000 fish across 25 species
content: A tragic incident has unfolded at Basin Run, where nearly 11,000 fish have succumbed to the consequences of a manure lagoon overflow from Kilby Farms. The Maryland Department of the Environment has traced the source of this discharge back to a series of ongoing pollution violations. Local residents, frustrated with the recurring environmental harm, are demanding accountability.

title: Delaware homeowner wins court order in dispute over HOA records, maintenance
content: In a noteworthy court case, Gwendolyn Colston took on her community developer without legal representation and secured a favorable ruling. The Delaware Court of Chancery instructed the developer to ensure the upkeep of ponds and drainage systems in the area. Additionally, Colston gained access to insights on a contentious $44,329.

title: Cabinet adopts resolution hailing achievements of PM Modi
content: Cabinet has adopted a resolution recognizing Narendra Modi's 25 years of public service as Chief Minister and Prime Minister. This resolution highlights various policies that benefited the common man, showcasing Modi's governance style. It mentions key initiatives like SWAGAT and PRAGATI that improved governance and service delivery. Additionally, it discusses welfare schemes that helped millions escape poverty and empowered women in society.

title: Astronomers find ‘phoenix planet’ born from ashes of a dying star
content: A team of astronomers has discovered a second-generation planet orbiting a white dwarf named HS 0209+0832. This planet formed from the material that the white dwarf expelled during its death. The atmosphere of the white dwarf contains heavy elements such as zinc, copper, and niobium. This discovery could change the way astronomers search for similar planets around dead stars.

title: Travis Kelce’s 87 & Running Foundation: Why are his parents stepping in?
content: Travis Kelce’s 87 & Running Foundation has not posted since January 2026. They continue their charitable work through Operation Breakthrough’s Ignition Lab. Donna Kelce met with Ignition Lab students during a Kansas City Chiefs game. Ed Kelce visited first graders at Operation Breakthrough. Travis Kelce’s foundation got its first post after January on Travis’ birthday.

title: Travis and Jason Kelce’s $10,000 donation: How did it help Laila Edwards’ family?
content: Earlier this year, Travis and Jason Kelce quietly donated $10,000 to help a Team USA hockey star’s family travel to Milan for the 2026 Winter Olympics. The contribution supported a $50,000 fundraiser created after the family struggled to afford the trip. Travis also offered encouragement before the Olympic debut, while Jason and Kylie attended the gold-medal game. Team USA eventually defeated Canada 2-1 in overtime for gold.

title: British Indian peer Lord Ranger wins right to judicial review of CBE annulment
content: Lord Rami Ranger has successfully challenged the decision to revoke his CBE by King Charles. The revocation was based on allegations of breaching the parliamentary code of conduct. Justice Nathalie Lieven ruled that the decision could be subject to judicial review due to its significant personal consequences. Lord Ranger's legal team argues that due process was not followed in the decision-making process.

title: Jammu and Kashmir: Arms & drugs seized in cross-border smuggling case; 4 held
content: J&K Police arrested four suspects linked to cross-border drug and arms smuggling. The police seized a Beretta pistol, magazines, live rounds, and narcotics during this operation. Initial arrests occurred when two men were stopped at a checkpoint and found with heroin and a firearm. This investigation revealed connections with handlers based in Pakistan and previous air-dropped consignments. The case has been registered under relevant laws with further investigation ongoing.

title: 'I am already sleepy': Jet-lagged Shreyas Iyer's candid reply after maiden T20I ton
content: Shreyas Iyer basked in the glory of his Asian Games gold medal before stepping up to lead India in the T20I series against West Indies. His outstanding innings of 102 not out off just 43 balls propelled India to victory. Iyer acknowledged the challenges of travel but showcased his adaptability. Meanwhile, debutant Naman Dhir shone with three wickets, cementing a solid bowling effort.

title: Pakistan successfully test-fires extended version of Fatah-4 cruise missile
content: Pakistan successfully conducted a test of its extended-version Fatah-4 cruise missile, which can hit long-range targets. The missile was able to validate various technical parameters, enhancing its precision and survivability. High-ranking military officials and government leaders were present to witness the launch and praised the effort. The Fatah-4 missile, operating at low altitudes, aims to evade detection from air defenses.

title: Garba’s new luxury flex: Valet, VVIP seats and butlers
content: During this year's Navratri, vadodara's garba events have embraced luxury, offering participants premium packages that promise comfort and exclusivity. Attendees can enjoy benefits like valet parking, VIP seating, and personalized services to enhance their experience. Special packages are also available for non-resident Indians and out-of-state guests seeking convenience. Meanwhile, Ahmedabad is stepping up with high-priced options, indicating a broader shift toward exquisite and lavish festival celebrations.

title: Why Dybala and Molina are blocked from Messi’s farewell despite 2022 squad invite
content: Paulo Dybala and Nahuel Molina will miss Lionel Messi’s Argentina farewell after Roma blocked their trip to Buenos Aires. The club cited the lengthy journey and proximity of important fixtures, with manager Gian Piero Gasperini stressing the demanding schedule. Both players remain linked to Argentina’s 2022 World Cup triumph, but neither was selected for the current international window.

title: EU ready to send observers for first Palestinian parliamentary vote in nearly 20 years
content: The European Union has expressed its commitment to send election observers for the upcoming Palestinian legislative elections on November 28, marking the first such elections in 17 years. This pivotal moment allows Palestinians the chance to choose their leaders following a prolonged hiatus. However, logistical hurdles, largely due to restrictions imposed by Israel in occupied regions, pose significant challenges.

title: Shreyas Iyer's maiden T20I century powers India to eight-wicket win over West Indies
content: In a thrilling opening match of the series, Shreyas Iyer reached his maiden T20I century, finishing with a stunning 102 runs off just 43 balls. This remarkable innings paved the way for India's eight-wicket triumph over West Indies. Debutant Naman Dhir made a mark too, claiming three wickets as the Windies were limited to 171 runs. India now leads the series 1-0, showcasing their prowess in both batting and bowling.

title: Anirudh Thapa goal a brief bright spot as Uruguay run riot against India
content: India ended their three-match home friendly window with a 1-6 defeat to Uruguay at Salt Lake Stadium on Tuesday. Anirudh Thapa's goal briefly gave the home faithfuls something to celebrate. But in a game of two halves, Uruguay found their scoring shoes with Darwin Nunez, Maxi Araujo, Rodrigo Zalazar, Juan Manuel Sanabria and Rodrigo Aguirre hitting the back of the net.

title: Mandhana era begins: Shafali Verma, Deepti Sharma named India vice-captains
content: Shafali Verma and Deepti Sharma have been appointed as vice-captains for the T20I and ODI teams. This leadership change follows Harmanpreet Kaur's resignation as captain, while she continues as a player. Smriti Mandhana has been appointed full-time captain and will lead the team in upcoming series. The new leadership group will face Zimbabwe in a three-match T20I series and three ODIs.

title: Humiliation, torn clothes and badges: Delhi women cops allege assault at protest sites
content: A senior Delhi Police officer addressed the treatment of women police personnel during ongoing protests. She highlighted incidents of misbehaviour and assault faced by these personnel while on duty. Videos circulating online show the challenges that women police officers encounter at protest sites.

title: Smriti Mandhana replaces Harmanpreet Kaur as India captain: ‘Very special honour’
content: Smriti Mandhana has been appointed as the new captain of the Indian women's cricket team. She takes over the leadership role from Harmanpreet Kaur, who announced her resignation as captain. Mandhana has led India in several T20Is and ODIs prior to this appointment. The Board of Control for Cricket in India expressed confidence in her leadership abilities. Harmanpreet will remain part of the squad as a player during this transition.

title: Lithuania ready to cover cost if US establishes military base
content: Lithuanian Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius has declared his willingness to finance the establishment of a permanent US military base in Lithuania. Since 2019, Lithuania has been hosting a rotating US battalion and is eager for a long-term military presence. Concurrently, the Lithuanian parliament is considering lifting constitutional prohibitions on nuclear weapons, a move that has drawn sharp criticism from Russia, citing heightened regional tensions.

title: BCCI secretary Saikia explains why VVS Laxman attended selection meeting | Exclusive
content: VVS Laxman, the head of the BCCI Centre of Excellence, took part in an important senior selection meeting intended to enhance the dialogue between national selectors and the Centre. BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia specified that Laxman's aim was to ensure better communication about player fitness and availability, a crucial step as the team prepares for their imminent tour of New Zealand.

title: FIR against BJP BLA over 'false' Form-7 applications, first in Telangana
content: An FIR has been lodged against BJP Booth Level Agent S Balachander for allegedly filing false voter deletion requests. The complaint, initiated by an election official, triggered a police inquiry. Congress leaders claim these submissions aim to unjustly disenfranchise valid voters from the electoral list. In response, Telangana’s Chief Electoral Officer has ordered District Election Officers to take action against these fraudulent applications.

title: 'Dhappa': Cops tried to stop INDIA bloc march to EC; Rahul pulled a surprise
content: Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra gave the INDIA bloc protest against the Election Commission an unexpected second act after police tried to stop INDIA bloc march against Gyanesh Kumar and began detaining opposition MPs.

title: DRDO conducts maiden live jump of advanced high-altitude parachute in Ladakh
content: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully executed its first live jump with the advanced high-altitude parachute system in Nyoma, from a height of 16,000 feet. This successful jump verified the parachute's effectiveness for mass drops, ensuring safety at high altitudes. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh commended this milestone as a testament to Aatmanirbhar Bharat, showcasing the synergy of India's defence entities.

title: US House moves to honour Indian Flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar; condemn 'act of terrorism'
content: The US House of Representatives has honored Captain Smit Machchhar through a formal resolution, celebrating his courageous defense of the aircraft against a treacherous act by his co-pilot that placed all lives at risk. The flight safely reached Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, ensuring the passengers' safety. This resolution also acknowledged the vital contributions of off-duty pilots and crew members during the incident.

title: Bhuvneshwar returns as India announce T20I and India A squads for New Zealand series
content: In a surprising turn of events, Bhuvneshwar Kumar has been reinstated to the Indian T20I squad, as declared by the BCCI. Shreyas Iyer will take the helm as captain, supported by wicketkeepers Sanju Samson and Ishan Kishan. The India A team features rising stars like Rishabh Pant and KL Rahul, who are keen on capturing the selectors' attention.

4.9-magnitude earthquake hits Uttarakhand's Chamoli, tremors felt in Delhi-NCR
content:
Photo for representation.

Earthquake tremors were felt across Delhi-NCR on Tuesday. According to the National Centre for Seismology, a magnitude 4.9 earthquake struck Uttarakhand's Chamoli district at 10.23 pm. The quake occurred at a depth of 13 km, with its epicentre located at 30.103°N latitude and 79.561°E longitude. Tremors were felt in parts of Delhi-NCR. There were no immediate reports of casualties or major damage. More details awaited.
